note: Configurable external creation tool metadata for BUILD WITH GRIOT. GRIOT guides users through these platforms via clear instructions and prompts without claiming direct automated control of external accounts.

tools.name: Lovable
tools.freeTierAvailability: Free starter allowance available with daily message limits (verify current plan limits on lovable.dev).
tools.costConsiderations: Starts with a free daily prompt allowance; paid monthly tiers required for higher prompt volume, private projects, or custom domains.
strengths: Builds full visual websites and web apps from plain-English prompts
Live interactive preview right inside the browser
One-click publishing and optional Supabase backend connection
Extremely approachable for non-technical founders and beginners
limitations: Daily prompt limits on the free tier
Primarily targets React/Tailwind web apps rather than native mobile binaries or low-level systems
requiredUserSetup: Create a free account at lovable.dev
Open the main prompt box on the Lovable dashboard
recommendedUseCases: Non-technical founders building a landing page, customer portal, booking directory, or MVP web app
Rapid visual prototyping with minimal configuration

navigationGuide.openPlatform: Open your browser and go to https://lovable.dev, then sign in.
navigationGuide.whereToPastePrompt: Click the main chat/prompt input box in the center of the Lovable dashboard (or the left chat sidebar inside an open project), paste the GRIOT prompt, and press Enter.
navigationGuide.whereToSeeResult: Watch the live preview pane on the right side of the Lovable workspace update once generation finishes.

tools.name: Replit
tools.freeTierAvailability: Free starter workspace available with limited cloud runtime/credits (verify current Replit Core/Starter terms on replit.com).
tools.costConsiderations: Starter account is free for learning and basic prototypes; Replit Core subscription or usage credits required for full Replit Agent builds and always-on deployments.
strengths: Zero local installation required — runs entirely in the browser
Supports Python, Node.js, HTML/CSS/JS, APIs, bots, and databases
Built-in live preview, console output, and one-click deployment
limitations: Free workspaces sleep when inactive and have resource caps
Full autonomous Replit Agent usage typically requires a paid plan
requiredUserSetup: Click '+ Create Repl' or use the AI prompt box on the home dashboard
recommendedUseCases: Beginners and intermediate builders creating web apps, Python scripts, automations, or backend APIs in the browser without installing local developer tools

navigationGuide.openPlatform: Open https://replit.com in your browser and sign in.
navigationGuide.whereToPastePrompt: Click 'Create Repl' (or the AI chat tab in your workspace), paste the GRIOT instructions or code into the editor/chat, and click 'Run'.
navigationGuide.whereToSeeResult: Check the 'Webview' preview tab and the 'Console' tab on the right side of the Replit screen.

tools.name: Google Antigravity
tools.freeTierAvailability: Preview/free usage tiers depend on your Google account and workspace quota.
tools.costConsiderations: Ideal for builders who want full codebase ownership, local or workspace execution, and deep agentic engineering without vendor lock-in.
strengths: Full agentic IDE capable of creating files, running terminal commands, and testing full-stack apps
Supports complex multi-file architectures, mobile apps, APIs, and custom databases
You own 100% of the generated source code locally
limitations: Requires opening an IDE workspace and basic familiarity with folders/terminal prompts compared to single-click website builders
requiredUserSetup: Open Google Antigravity IDE and select or create a project workspace folder
Open the Agent chat pane on the right side of the workspace
recommendedUseCases: Builders with some technical curiosity or ambitious full-stack, mobile, or custom AI applications who want complete code ownership

navigationGuide.openPlatform: Launch Google Antigravity on your computer and open your project folder.
navigationGuide.whereToPastePrompt: Click the Agent chat input box, paste the exact GRIOT step prompt, and submit.
navigationGuide.whereToSeeResult: Review the created files in the Explorer sidebar and open the local preview URL or terminal output reported by the agent.

tools.name: n8n / Make (Visual Workflow Automation)
tools.freeTierAvailability: n8n can be self-hosted for free (open-source fair-code), and Make.com offers a free tier with monthly operation limits.
tools.costConsiderations: Self-hosted n8n is free; managed cloud plans charge per workflow execution.
strengths: Connects WhatsApp, Gmail, Google Sheets, forms, webhooks, and AI without writing backend boilerplate
Visual step-by-step node canvas shows exactly where an automation succeeds or fails
limitations: Designed for backend workflows and triggers rather than custom visual consumer storefronts
requiredUserSetup: Create an account on Make.com or launch n8n
recommendedUseCases: Automating customer notifications, invoice generation, WhatsApp/email replies, lead capture, and daily business reports

navigationGuide.openPlatform: Open your n8n or Make.com workspace and click 'Create Workflow'.
navigationGuide.whereToPastePrompt: Follow GRIOT's step-by-step node configuration and paste the provided JSON/webhook payload or AI prompt into the designated node field.
navigationGuide.whereToSeeResult: Click 'Test Workflow / Run Once' and verify that each node turns green with the expected output data.
